items.title: Akamai beats quarterly estimates on cloud infrastructure demand
items.summary: Akamai Technologies beat analysts' estimates for the second ‌quarter on Thursday, supported ‌by steady demand across its security and ​cloud infrastructure services portfolios, sending its shares up 10.5% in extended trading. The company recorded cloud infrastructure services ‌revenue of $99 million, ⁠up 39% over the year earlier. Here are some details: • ⁠The cybersecurity and cloud computing company's customers include Adobe, eBay and ​Electronic Arts, ​as well ​as the U.S. ‌defense and labor departments.

items.title: eBay beats second-quarter expectations but mixed guidance limits share gains
items.summary: eBay Inc. (NASDAQ:EBAY) reported stronger-than-expected second-quarter earnings and revenue, although the stock posted only modest gains in premarket trading on Thursday after the online marketplace issued mixed guidance for the current quarter.

items.title: Fashion’s biggest brands spent years letting eBay and Depop resell their clothes. Now, they want the money
items.summary: Secondhand apparel is on track to hit $393 billion by 2030—and brands no longer want eBay and Poshmark collecting all of it.
